name: B10-0124/2024 (Renew) – Urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for the European Union's rules on medical devices to be reviewed. It says patients in some countries face shortages of devices, and that smaller companies struggle with long, costly certification. It wants the rules to be clearer, faster and less burdensome, while keeping patient safety high. It also wants the review to look at reliance on suppliers outside the European Union and at protection of personal medical data.

- No law changes yet; Parliament asks for a review of the medical devices rules by 2027 at the latest.
- Affects patients, healthcare workers, device makers and certification bodies across the European Union.
- Next: the Commission is asked to act and to run a full evaluation with all interested parties involved.
